headline: Logan September passengers were 3,596,049, down 0.6%
fact: Massport's September 2026 Logan traffic summary reports 3,596,049 total airport passengers, down 0.6% from 3,616,472 in September 2025. Domestic passengers were 2,705,747, down 2.0%, and international passengers were 881,324, up 3.9%. Calendar year-to-date passengers were 32,688,371, down 0.2%.
source: Massachusetts Port Authority, Boston-Logan Monthly Airport Traffic Summary, September 2026

headline: DFW September passengers rose 3.5% to 7,059,251; year-to-date is down 0.5%
fact: DFW Airport's official September 2026 passenger report shows 7,059,251 total passengers, up 3.5% from 6,823,482 in September 2025. Domestic traffic was 6,136,806, up 3.3%, and international traffic was 922,445, up 4.2%. Calendar year-to-date passengers were 63,882,648, down 0.5%.

headline: Nashville October passengers were 2,708,302, with enplanements up 4.8% and deplanements up 4.1%
fact: The Metropolitan Nashville Airport Authority's October 2026 detail traffic report shows 1,351,105 enplaned passengers, up 4.8%, and 1,357,197 deplaned passengers, up 4.1%, for a combined 2,708,302 passengers. Fiscal year-to-date total passengers were 10,102,511, up 6.0%.
source: Metropolitan Nashville Airport Authority, Detail Traffic Statistics, October 2026

headline: Dulles July passengers were 2,819,238, down 0.1%; trailing-12-month volume is down 0.8%
fact: MWAA's July 2026 air traffic statistics, published September 8, 2026, report 2,819,238 total passengers at Washington Dulles, down 0.1% from 2,823,021 in July 2025. The last 12 months through July were 28,559,656 passengers, down 0.8% from 28,791,085. This updates the May 2026 last-12-months figure used in batch 1.
source: Metropolitan Washington Airports Authority, Air Traffic Statistics, July 2026

headline: Reagan National July passengers were 2,174,752, up 0.8%
fact: The same MWAA July 2026 report shows 2,174,752 total passengers at Reagan National, up 0.8% from 2,156,550 in July 2025. Trailing-12-month passengers through July were 24,914,053. Totals include general aviation and military, as printed. Later monthly PDFs for August and September 2026 were not found at predictable MWAA file paths.
source: Metropolitan Washington Airports Authority, Air Traffic Statistics, July 2026

headline: Orlando's November 2026 average daily schedule is 531 departures and 95,319 seats
fact: GOAA's November 2026 average daily departures addendum, published in late October, shows 531 daily departures, up 0.6%, and 95,319 daily seats, up 0.2%, serving 162 destinations, up 3.8%. Frontier is listed at 59 daily departures, up 30.7%, with seats up 36.3%; Breeze departures are up 48.6%; Southwest is listed at 166 daily departures, up 8.8%; and Spirit is listed at zero, down 100%. An official September or October 2026 monthly passenger PDF was still not posted on the GOAA traffic-statistics page.
source: Greater Orlando Aviation Authority, November 2026 Average Daily Departures

headline: Philadelphia August passengers fell 3.9% to 2,952,135; year-to-date is down 0.3%
fact: Philadelphia International Airport's August 2026 aviation activity report shows 2,952,135 total passengers, down 3.9% from 3,070,952 in August 2025. Domestic passengers were 2,465,175, down 4.7%, and international passengers were 486,960, up 0.7%. Calendar year-to-date passengers were 20,307,128, down 0.3%. A September 2026 report was not yet posted.
source: Philadelphia International Airport, Aviation Activity Report, August 2026

headline: Austin-Bergstrom September passengers rose 5.1% to 1,817,572; year-to-date is up 4.15%
fact: The City of Austin / Austin-Bergstrom International Airport news release dated October 30, 2026, reports 1,817,572 arriving and departing passengers in September, up 5.1% from September 2025. September enplanements were 903,881, up 5.79%. January-September 2026 passenger traffic was 16,526,244, up 4.15%.
source: City of Austin / Austin-Bergstrom International Airport, September 2026 Passenger, Cargo Traffic news release

headline: Tampa September passengers rose 0.38% to 1,719,082; year-to-date is down 2.15%
fact: Hillsborough County Aviation Authority's September 2026 AirStats report shows 1,719,082 total passengers at Tampa International, up 0.38% from 1,712,634 in September 2025. Domestic traffic was 1,599,819, down 0.25%, and international traffic was 119,263, up 9.68%. Calendar year-to-date passengers were 18,310,583, down 2.15%, and rolling-12-month passengers were 24,407,963, down 0.54%.
source: Hillsborough County Aviation Authority, HCAA AirStats Monthly Activity Report, September 2026

headline: Detroit Metro September passengers fell 2.8% to 2,641,351; year-to-date is down 3.3%
fact: Wayne County Airport Authority's September 2026 aviation statistics report shows 2,641,351 total passengers at Detroit Metro, down 2.8% from 2,716,886 in September 2025. Domestic passengers were 2,340,699, down 3.3%, and international passengers were 300,652, up 1.9%. Calendar year-to-date passengers were 24,420,816, down 3.3%.
source: Wayne County Airport Authority, September 2026 Aviation Statistics Report, Detroit Metropolitan Airport

headline: Delta planned added Detroit-Hawaii flying in the winter 2026-27 schedule
fact: Delta's February 13, 2026, Hawaii schedule announcement said the winter program would include added flying from Detroit, as well as Atlanta and New York JFK, beginning with the December 2026 holiday period. The release did not print a city-pair frequency table for the Detroit additions.
source: Delta News Hub, Lei-ing down Delta's largest Hawaii schedule

headline: Minneapolis-St. Paul September passengers rose 1.6% to 2,908,043; year-to-date is down 2.0%
fact: The Metropolitan Airports Commission's September 2026 monthly operations report shows 2,908,043 total passengers at MSP (1,443,818 deplaned and 1,464,225 enplaned), up 1.6% from 2,861,527 in September 2025. Calendar year-to-date passengers were 27,085,134, down 2.0% from 27,630,136.
source: Metropolitan Airports Commission, MSP September 2026 Monthly Operations Report

headline: Delta will start Minneapolis-Maui nonstops on December 19, 2026
fact: Delta announced on February 13, 2026, that it will launch nonstop service between Minneapolis-St. Paul and Maui beginning December 19, 2026. The route will operate daily during peak holiday and spring-break periods and five times weekly through the core winter season on Airbus A330-300 aircraft.
source: Delta News Hub, Lei-ing down Delta's largest Hawaii schedule

headline: Palm Beach September terminal passengers fell 3.6% to 480,992; trailing 12 months are up 0.8%
fact: The airport's official September 2026 traffic report, titled for President Donald J. Trump International Airport (PBI), shows 480,992 total terminal passengers, down 3.6% from 498,729 in September 2025. The 12 months ended September 2026 totaled 8,642,697 passengers, up 0.8% from 8,576,888. Estimated seat capacity in September rose 5.7% while the estimated load factor fell 6.8 points to 70.5%.
source: Palm Beach County Department of Airports, Traffic Report for the period ended September 2026
